contentPattern.structure: profile card groups from a DA sheet (name + role + image per row, grouped, optional per-group intro)

config.source: path to a DA sheet ending in .json, e.g. /us/en/about-us/query-index.json (columns: name, role, image, group, intro)

suitableFor: team / contributor / guide bio groups maintained in a DA sheet (About Us)

notes: Reads the sheet, splits rows by `group`, and renders one cards-profile grid per group with a heading and optional intro. Delegates card + social-row rendering to cards-profile. DA project, no _model file.
